summary: Full E2E verification of Keneth Global Inc after fresh import. Updated backend_test.py to match the new catalog state (31 products across masalas/home-furnishing/artificial-jewelry/christmas-decor, new categories dry-fruits + nuts, 10 new masala products). Ran pytest: 40 passed, 4 skipped (Stripe-config-gated). Verified desktop (1920) + mobile (390) UI: home, shop/masalas with category filters, product detail with real images for all 10 new products, cart, graceful 503 'Payments are unavailable' toast on checkout, admin login + /admin dashboard, FSSAI Certificate section (Summary + Certificate tabs with preview image + open/download links).
critical_code_review_comments: Checkout graceful degradation works as designed: POST /api/checkout/session returns 503 with a clear 'Payments are unavailable…' message and the frontend surfaces it as a toast while keeping the cart intact.

Static product images are served under /api/static/products/… with correct image/* content-type for all 10 new products (cumin-seeds, star-anise-whole, cloves-whole, black-cardamom, cinnamon-bark, black-peppercorns, medjool-dates, ajwa-dates, cashew-nuts, pistachios).

Category tree in /api/products/verticals and category filtering by slug exactly match the new structure: masalas={blended:3, single:2, whole:7, dry-fruits:2, nuts:2} = 16; christmas-decor=4; totals verified in UI (filter buttons category-dry-fruits, category-nuts, category-whole-spices etc).
Admin role gating holds: customer tokens receive 403 on /api/admin/*; invalid JWT returns 401; password_hash never leaked in /api/admin/users responses.
test_credentials: admin@kenethglobal.com / Admin@Keneth2026 (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Customers created ad-hoc with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: No new persistent seed data. Tests create TEST_ customers and a TEST wholesale enquiry; no destructive admin changes (price-patch tests revert).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://keneth-prod-check.preview.emergentagent.com used throughout. Stripe is intentionally unconfigured (sk_test_emergent placeholder); checkout returns HTTP 503 and the UI shows a friendly 'Payments are unavailable' toast — treat as expected until real Stripe test keys are provided. Catalog has 31 products; masalas vertical has 16 across 5 categories including the new dry-fruits + nuts. Certificate section data-testids: home-certificate-section / certificate-tab-summary / certificate-tab-certificate / certificate-preview-image / certificate-open-full / certificate-download-full — all verified.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Previous backend_test.py expectations were pinned to the pre-expansion catalog (17 products, 3 verticals) and would have failed against the new 31-product catalog — updated to new counts (31 total; masalas 16 with dry-fruits=2, nuts=2, whole-spices=7). Added test_new_products_exist_with_images that fetches each of the 10 new slugs and verifies /api/static image bytes are served.
